bio: Assembly, integration and verification manager for SHARK-NIR; also works on adaptive-optics and telescope instrumentation.
long_bio: Luca works on integrating and commissioning astronomical instrumentation, including leading assembly, integration and verification activities for SHARK-NIR. He also contributes to laboratory and adaptive-optics projects, including MATTO and next-generation instrument programmes. His focus is the passage from optical designs and individual subsystems to working, tested instruments.
